caption: Mid-summer is when it catches up with them. Month after month of runs, hauls, and hard work — and most horses haven't had anyone check whether everything is still moving right. They compensate quietly until they can't. Dr. Leo comes to your barn across North Texas and the Great Falls area, checks the whole horse, and frees up whatever's gotten stuck. No trailering. No stress. Just a horse that feels better and works better. July slots are going fast. Book now — shortgochiro.com or call (406) 799-3369.
